documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Srivari Spices and Foods Limited reported its H1 FY26 financial results with revenue of Rs. 78.77 crores, EBITDA of Rs. 13.43 crores, and PAT of Rs. 7.20 crores, delivering a 49.08% year-on-year revenue growth. Management expressed optimism for stronger performance in the second half of the fiscal year, driven by better margins and ramp-ups in new segments like edible oils and soya chunks.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment continues to be encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment continues to be encouraging and we are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of approximately 6 percent from 2024 to 2029.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 –2029, driven by rising health awareness and higher protein consumption.

demand_outlook.claim: Over 70 percent of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake.
demand_outlook.quote: Over 70% of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake (Source: Indian Market Research Bureau).

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that groundnut oil sales generally account for 7% to 8% of the overall oil segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Generally, overall if you see the positioning of the groundnut oil is percentage wise 7% to 8% is the overall sales of this oil segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that 70% of the spices market is still unorganized trade.
demand_outlook.quote: As I said, one important thing is in the spices, still 70% is an unorganized trade.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that 70% of atta is in the loose atta which is unorganized.
demand_outlook.quote: As well as atta is also same, 70% is in the loose atta which is unorganized.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on puja articles and devotional goods.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on manufacturing, trading and distribution of puja articles, devotional goods, festival related items and allied products.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that they are planning to launch a plant for soya chunks after two quarters.
capex_expansion.quote: Install the capacity later, after 2 quarters.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai, Maharashtra on July 28, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai, Maharashtra on 28 July 2025 .

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched its edible oil on 10th May 2025 and started its commercial production on the same day.
capex_expansion.quote: and we launched our edible oil on 10th May 2025 and it started its commercial production on 10th May 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: The installed capacity for spices and masalas is 3,600 tons per annum with a current utilization of about 2,637 tons.
capex_expansion.quote: For spices and masalas, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons per annum with the current utilization at about 2,637 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The installed capacity for atta is 14,400 tons per annum with a utilization of 12,650 tons.
capex_expansion.quote: When it comes to atta, 14,400 tons per annum installed capacity and we have utilized 12,650 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The installed capacity for oil is 7,200 tons per annum, but the plant is yet to be commercialized.
capex_expansion.quote: Regarding oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons per annum but this plant is yet to be commercialized.

margins_costs.claim: For the first half of FY26, the company recorded an EBITDA margin of 17.05% and a PAT margin of 9.14%.
margins_costs.quote: Our profitability remained healthy with EBITDA margin of 17.05% and PAT margin of 9.14%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the monthly spend on media channels is Rs. 5 to Rs. 6 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: So, altogether monthly we are spending Rs. 5-Rs. 6 lakhs on the media channels, new media channels.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin for H1 FY26 was reported at 17.05 percent.
The profit margin for H1 FY26 was reported at 9.14 percent.
Management reported that net profit decreased due to the new plant commencement and claiming 6 months of depreciation.
margins_costs.quote: Our PAT has been decreased. See PAT has been decreased due to the new plant commencement and we have claimed the depreciation of the 6 months because of that PAT has been decreased, but our overall numbers are positive.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that gross profit is positive around INR0.12.
margins_costs.quote: Our gross profit are positive in around INR0.12.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for spices is 3,600 tons with a utilization of 2,637 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: For Spices, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons and we have utilized 2,637 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for atta is 14,400 tons with a utilization of 12,650 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: And when it comes to Atta, installed capacity is 14,400 tons and we have utilized 12,650 tons.

capital_allocation.claim: Rights shares were issued on October 10, 2024 to enhance the capital structure.
capital_allocation.quote: Rights Shares issued on 10th Oct, 2024 to enhance capital structure.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the bank facility limit is INR12 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: INR12 crores is a facility, INR200 lakhs is a facility with the banking.

risks_headwinds.claim: An overdraft taken on the last day of September contributed to the increase in short-term borrowings.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually, mainly there was one OD came on the last day of September. So, that contributed so much towards short-term borrowings.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that growth targets were not reached last year because of challenges of the new setup and delay in rights.
risks_headwinds.quote: and we didn't reach out in the last year that we do because of the challenges of this new setup. It's a huge setup and second thing was the delay in the rights.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the new puja and devotional products vertical will be launched in January.
management_commitments.quote: In Jan, roughly in the Jan, we are going to launch.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that oil capacity utilization can reach up to 30% in H2.
management_commitments.quote: Now, we can utilize up to 30% in this H2.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated an intention to expand into Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, and Odisha.
management_commitments.quote: So, now our growth will be from next focused states will be Karnataka and Tamil Nadu as well as Maharashtra and Odisha soon.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
